name: mtsport/sps
description: MT-SPORT Slovak Parcel Service (SPS) integration — Balikovo pickup-point selection in checkout, order persistence, and automatic WebShip SOAP shipment/label creation on order state transition.

description.en-GB: Stores selected SPS Balikovo pickup points per order and creates WebShip shipments/labels automatically on order state change. Exposes POST /store-api/mtsport-sps/pickup-point.
description.sk-SK: Ukladá vybrané výdajné miesta SPS Balíkovo k objednávke a automaticky vytvára zásielky/štítky cez WebShip pri zmene stavu objednávky.
